reviews.comment: Dr.H is amazing! Her Historian's craft topic was very interesting and she provided great guidance in helping you write the final paper. She provides great feedback on the writing assignments and is fair on her grading. Overall the class is not difficult and she's very nice and is happy to answer questions.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Dr. Herzogenrath was a great professor. The assignments were simple and graded fairly with clear grading criteria. Her lectures were engaging and she made them immersive and interesting. If you do all the assignments and go to class, you will have an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The sweetest! You can tell she cares a lot for her students! I learned a lot, and her class was never boring. She was extremely understanding always, and never acts like her class is the only thing you do all day. Love her!

Such a sweet professor, you can tell she's genuine about her students. Her format of the class was very effective, and her lectures are so informative/eye opening. I truly learned a lot and was engaged/interested even though I'm not a history person at all. Take her if you can, she's awesome truly.

Dr. H made this class very interesting and interactive. There were no exams but lots of writing assignments which I preferred. You must attend class as there are in-class assignments that make up a large portion of your grade. As long as you did the work, it is an easy class. Dr. H is great and has been one of my favorite professors.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Easily one of my favorite professors at TAMU! She makes learning history fun and I had a great time in her class. We had weekly assignments, but no tests which was great. We also had 3 assessment (projects) and they were a little time consuming but pretty fun to do. Take her if you have the chance!!!!
Dr. H was awesome! She taught history in a fun way that didn't bore you. She had us relate things to our personal lives, and all 3 of the assessments were fun projects that I learned a lot from.

Take this class for a history credit!!! Hybrid class and only meet on Thursdays for group work. NO TESTS!!! We have essays, projects, assignments, ton of grades but helps your grade if you complete everything. She grades pretty easy on major assignments but her TA who graded the weekly journal entries was extremely picky and graded way too hard.

I took Dr. H for Hist 105 and the class was only one day a week and it was a lot of discussion based but I found it really interesting and fun doing the in-class activities. There's 3 main assessments and weekly journal entries that aren't terrible but 100% better than a big lecture and test heavy history class. Highly recommend taking Dr. H!

One of the best professors at TAMU! Very kind and helpful in all aspects. Classes were a lot of group work and the final was a paper. No lecture slides, we mostly did research as a group or discussed ideas rather than watching her read off of slides, nice if that's your type of learning style. I'd reccomend her no matter what class you're taking!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. H was an amazing professor for HIST 105. There were no exams, so you don't have to memorize details. There was only one lecture a week that had an in class activity with a group. The journal entries are once a week and graded very clear. TAKE HER IF YOU CAN. I am waiting to see if she will teach 106 in this format.

Dr. H was one of the most caring profs I've ever had. Her class met once a week and we often did easy group projects as part of our grade. Her class consisted of no test and grades often came from in-class assignments and outside of class work. You can tell that Dr. H is passionate about teaching and making the learning environment engaging.

Dr. H is so sweet and such a great professor. Her class was designed in a way where you meet once a week and do group collaborations. They are super easy and she gives good feedback. She grades things a bit slow, but she is not a hard grader at all and she genuinely reads through all your work! Take her! She is the best!!

Take Dr. H for HIST105 if you want an easy credit toward your degree! The class only meets once a week for around 75 minutes (attendance mandatory). There are no tests, only 4 assessments (video essays/essays/projects). The rest of the grade is easy journal entries, peer reviews, and in-class assignments. She is a really good & kind lecturer too!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Her class is all about group projects and class discussions. The class discussions are very interesting and group work is super easy. There aren't any exams, only a few papers over the course of the semester. HIGHLY recommend taking Professor Herzogenrath she is the BEST!!!

One of the best professors I have had. Her lectures are super interesting and you never get bored. Her way of teaching is amazing where there are no exams, just in-class assignments, weekly journal entries, and some big projects. This format really helped me learn in a better way. TAKE HER!!!!

If you can, take this prof!!! Dr. H is amazing. She makes lecture and the learning materials all very interesting. I would not say that this class is easy, but if you put in the work, you will get an A. VERY writing intensive, so be ready for that! Also, attendance is mandatory and classes are filled with group projects and class participation.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor H is absolutely amazing. She is funny, kind, genuine, and makes a generic history course so much fun through interactive class activities and projects. Definitely take her if you have the chance. You will love this class especially if you like to write.

Dr. H is very passionate about what she teaches. Attendance is mandatory because of in-class activities, but there are no tests. Grades are based on 4 writing assignments and weekly journals. Very easy class. She is caring and very nice. Loved her and the class environment!

Dr. H is very nice and passionate about what she teaches. Great class to not put in very much effort and still learn some valuable things. Class is mandatory because of in class activities that cannot be completed later. 10/10 great prof
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Very fun Professor! Didn't believe in exams, so we pretty much had completion grades for every assignment, one of my favorite college classes I've taken.

BEST PROF EVER!!! No tests or quizzes, only weekly journals. If you give the journals your all you'll do great. She's such a caring and genuine person. I would def retake her class again if I could. LOVE LOVE LOVE this woman

Probably one of the best professors I will EVER have. She genuinely cares SO much about her students, gives amazing feedback and is so understanding. The class has to do with reading a lot of primary sources and writing, but she doesn't grade harshly at all. You MUST show up to class because there are in-class activities (mostly in groups). 1000/10

Professor Herzogenrath is by far one of the nicest professors I've ever had. Her class is focused on reading primary sources and thinking critically rather than just memorizing facts. So instead of exams, there were projects, which I personally enjoy a lot more than having to stress out over a test.

Dr. H is an extremely good professor! I wasn't quite sure what to expect from a college history course, and it was her first time teaching at TAMU. However, even through the COVID-19 situation, I learned a lot. She helped me develop my writing and critical thinking skills, and the class was a nice break from all my other STEM courses.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: If you have the chance, please take Professor H. She is not only the kindest, most caring professor that I have ever experienced, but she genuinely made me excited to learn about history. There was never a day when I wasn't excited to go to her class, and I absolutely adored having her as a professor. I highly recommend taking her class.

She is one of the sweetest most caring professors ever. Her class had a lot of group in-class activites which were annoying at times but the activities were always engaging and to help us learn. Weekly journals of 300 words are also required, and there are 4 assessments throughout the semester which are not difficult at all. Easy A but lots of hw

Dr. H is an amazing professor! She really wants her students to succeed and learn history from various perspectives. Make sure to attend her lectures since she does in-class activities. Definitely recommend taking HIST 105 with her

If you have the chance to take her, DO IT!!!! She is absolutely amazing and incredibly understanding about our other priorities outside of class. No tests, no quizzes. We have a few projects but they are all very fun and easy. She's a sweetheart and makes class lots of fun.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. H is the most caring professor I have had thus far. Make sure to show up and do the in class participation activities. Textbook and other resources are all free online! She really wants her students to learn and think critically from various perspectives. If you're looking for a history class take this one!

Professor Herzogenrath is an amazing prof. She is super laid back and caring of her students. The only grades we have are journal entries every week, 4 assessments, and no tests. I would highly recommend.

Dr. H is my favorite professor! She's so kind and you can tell she cares about her students. You have to show up to class because there's an in-class activity that's counted for a grade each time. There are also weekly journal entries and 4 projects. This class is not about memorization, but still allows you to learn! I highly recommend it!

I LOVED HER CLASS!! The most caring professor I have taken thus far at A&M. She was understanding with the online courses and covid. She answered all my emails in a timely manner. The class does not have any tests. It is based on weekly journal entries and 4 projects.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. H was great this semester and I plan on taking her again for HIST106. Grades are based off 300 word journal entries (about 1 per week), in-class activities, and the occasional assessment w/ peer reviews. She gives great feedback and comments on assignments and is very caring about all her students. BEST PROF EVER!

Great class with no Exams or Quizzes, Attendance is mandatory since there are in-class activities that you must submit by the end of class. Weekly Journal Entries, Online videos, and readings are part of the work for this class, with a couple of simple Projects. Dr. H is a very nice person and she makes sure we have fun while learning!
